cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Name My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get them to acknowledge exactly what your effort, sacrifice, or strategy added to the result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. When you thank the festival team, mention who repaired the stage in the rain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Wonderful. Which equal sentence includes my waterproof trousers?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You want your name in the speech?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Beside the part that kept the dancers above ground.
